headline: Batista brothers’ vehicle agrees to buy defense group Avibras
valueNote: Undisclosed. Valor reports the sale of 100% of the business.
highlights: Agreement signed Friday 21 Aug and reported Monday 24 Aug: Globe Investimentos, the personal vehicle of Joesley and Wesley Batista (separate from J&F/JBS), is buying all shares of Nova AVB, sole owner of Avibras Aeroco, subject to CADE review. Globe said the aim is to support the restart of operations after a 2022 bankruptcy filing and preserve industrial capability.

headline: Pátria closes sale of 99.56% voting control of Elfa Medicamentos
valueNote: Valor cites an acquisition price of R$ 620.49 million paid proportionally to selling Pátria funds (USD converted at window FX 5.16). Earnout if Gravataí sells Elfa within 36 months. Confirm unit against the CVM filing.
highlights: Elfa told the market on Monday that control passed from Pátria-managed funds to Gravataí Participações after a statutory liquidity event converted preferred shares. Buyer will ask CVM to waive a mandatory tag-along tender and says it will not cancel the public-company registration within one year.

headline: Afya and Yduqs confirm early talks on a business combination — no binding deal
valueNote: Undisclosed — not a signed transaction. Both companies said no binding agreement or obligation exists.
highlights: Yduqs (CVM material fact) and Afya (Nasdaq 6-K) confirmed preliminary talks on a possible combination after Valor reported Bertelsmann–Yduqs meetings in São Paulo. Both said discussions are early-stage with no assurance a deal will close. Yduqs shares jumped more than 8% in the Monday session on the news.

headline: nVent to acquire data-center power specialist Maverick Power for $1.75bn
valueNote: Headline consideration $1.75bn cash; up to $550m additional earn-out for 2027–28 targets is excluded from the KPI total.
highlights: Definitive agreement announced 24 Aug. Maverick (McKinney, Texas) makes low- and medium-voltage switchgear and modular power for data centers. nVent expects the deal to be accretive in year one, funded with cash and new debt, closing targeted for Q4 2026 subject to regulatory approval.

headline: Descartes acquires freight-broker TMS vendor Tai for about $100m cash
valueNote: Company disclosed approximately US$100 million, cash on hand.
highlights: Tai provides an AI-enabled transportation-management platform for freight brokers across TL, LTL, drayage and cross-border. Descartes said the deal adds execution data to its Global Logistics Network and expands TMS coverage for North American brokers.

headline: Berry Street merges with India’s Healthify to build a GLP-1 metabolic platform
valueNote: Undisclosed. Companies did not release financial terms.
highlights: U.S. nutrition/clinic network Berry Street and Healthify said they have merged, with founders Noah Kotlove and Tushar Vashisht as co-CEOs. Combined group keeps the Berry Street brand in the U.S. and Healthify elsewhere, pairing AI coaching with insurance-covered GLP-1 clinics.

headline: Regent agrees to buy Avon North America, reuniting Avon after a decade
highlights: Regent, founded by Michael A. Reinstein, agreed to acquire Avon North America from LG Household & Health Care, putting Avon NA and Avon International under one owner for the first time since 2016. Close targeted by 1 September; Lisa Siders to become CEO of the combined Avon.

highlights: Production would subscribe to Refinitiv, Bloomberg SPLC, and Dealogic for late-day North America and Asia prints. This row is not a transaction. It marks a missing live feed.

headline: Braskem board authorizes recuperação extrajudicial on US$10.9bn financial debt
valueNote: Not a deal value. Company is restructuring ~US$10.9bn of unsecured financial claims — excluded from M&A KPI totals.
highlights: Monday material-fact coverage: board authorized an extrajudicial reorganization limited to financial creditors (not suppliers or customers). Creditor support at filing was reported around the one-third threshold needed to start a 90-day stay as a June court protection expired. Preferred shares traded lower on the news.

target: Monday session: Iran sanctions watch, oil down, education spike
headline: Ibovespa slips as Petrobras tracks oil; Yduqs jumps on Afya talks
highlights: Around 10:25 BRT the Ibovespa was down ~1.0% at 169,365 as the market waited on U.S. sanctions on Iran and a Febraban Tech speech by BC president Gabriel Galípolo. Petrobras ON/PN fell ~2.0–2.5% with oil; Vale ON rose ~0.6% with Chinese iron ore; Yduqs ON was up ~8.5% after confirming Afya talks.

headline: Focus holds IPCA at 5.02% and year-end Selic at 13.75%; GDP edged to 1.95%
valueNote: Not a deal — official weekly survey.
highlights: BC Focus (24 Aug) left 2026 IPCA at 5.02% (above the 4.5% target ceiling) and the year-end Selic median at 13.75% for a third week, with current Selic at 14.00%. 2026 GDP was trimmed from 1.98% to 1.95%. FX year-end median stayed at R$ 5.20.
